Hagoromo, the Sage of the Six Paths, appears and explains to the four that Hashirama and Madara are the reincarnations of his sons Ashura and Indra. Hagoromo recounts the tale of how he founded Ninshu, the Ninja Creed, and about the lives of Ashura and Indra.

episodes.title: Ashura and Indra
episodes.overview: Hagoromo's two sons, Ashura and Indra, share a happy childhood, training and playing together. Indra is naturally gifted with great talent, and at a tender age is nicknamed the “genius of Ninshu.” On the other hand, Ashura has no aptitude for Ninshu. Still, the two boys are very close. But Hagoromo is unaware of the malevolent power stirring in the shadows…

episodes.title: The Tumultuous Journey
episodes.overview: Hagoromo sends the brothers to two battle-scarred regions left untouched since the fight with Ten Tails. He then announces that he will choose his successor depending on the outcome of their missions.

episodes.title: Ashura's Decision
episodes.overview: Ashura sets out on a journey, intending never to return. He ends up in a village where the people suffer from a mysterious illness.

episodes.title: The Successor
episodes.overview: Everyone believes that Indra is the best choice to be Hagomoro's successor, and the sage's indecision begins to cause anxiety among his followers. Finally, Ashura returns home, and Hagoromo reveals who he has chosen.

episodes.title: A Special Mission
episodes.overview: Finally, the truth will be revealed... Do not miss the unveiling of the legend.

episodes.title: Connecting Thoughts
episodes.overview: Before Naruto and Sasuke can attempt to seal Kaguya away, she transports Sasuke into a different Time-Space. Obito realizes that Kaguya’s ability to travel through Time-Space is similar to Kakashi’s and his own Visual Prowess. Obito and Sakura team up and begin the search for Sasuke.

episodes.title: The Two of Them...Always
episodes.overview: Fearing that he will once again break a promise, Obito uses the last of his power to bring Sasuke and Sakura back, but the thought of his inability to protect Rin nags at him as he loses consciousness.

episodes.title: You Better...
episodes.overview: Recalling the time when he shared Naruto’s desire to become Hokage, Obito opens up to Naruto about his dreams.

episodes.title: The Sharingan Revived
episodes.overview: Chakra—whose energy connects this world to those beyond—allows Obito to leave Rin's side for a moment and appear in Kakashi’s inner psyche. Obito gives him his Magekyo Sharingan and leaves with a parting wish that Kakashi become the Sixth Hokage.

episodes.title: Congratulations
episodes.overview: Team 7 joins forces and succeeds in sealing away Kaguya, and the Tailed Beasts that Kaguya absorbed are also freed. Black Zetsu escapes the seal to lie in wait for another time to resurrect his mother, but Naruto is not about to let him go!

episodes.title: The Final Valley
episodes.overview: The battle with Kaguya is over, and all that is left is for Naruto and Sasuke to combine their powers and release the Infinite Tsukuyomi. But before they can do this, Sasuke makes a shocking declaration.

episodes.title: The Final Battle
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke have both become such high-level shinobi that each knows exactly what the other is thinking just by exchanging attacks. Despite knowing how Naruto feels, Sasuke is determined to cut him down.

episodes.title: Naruto and Sasuke
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke have both become such high-level shinobi that each knows exactly what the other is thinking just by exchanging attacks. Despite knowing how Naruto feels, Sasuke is determined to cut him down.

episodes.title: The Unison Sign
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke are enveloped in a huge, intense light after exchanging attacks. When they come to, scenes from their childhood unfold. Is this just a figment of their imagination? Or could this be the afterlife?

episodes.title: Naruto Uzumaki!!
episodes.overview: "I'll be a better shinobi than Lord Hokage! Then all the villagers will have to acknowledge my existence at last!" True to his word, Naruto has walked his own path until there are none who do not recognize that he's become a great shinobi and a hero who has saved the world. But what path will Naruto take now? How will the world of the shinobi change? This is the story of the boy who blew through the hearts of all like a "shippu," an irresistible gale. This is the story of Naruto Uzumaki.

episodes.title: Naruto and Hinata
episodes.overview: As a result of having the Nine Tails sealed inside of him, Naruto is feared and hated by the villagers. He trains all alone in the woods, but one day, a certain man appears and strikes up a conversation with Naruto. Elsewhere, in the Leaf Village, a celebration is held to mark Hinata's third birthday, where she meets Neji for the first time.

episodes.title: Sasuke and Sakura
episodes.overview: As a child, Sasuke craved attention from his older brother Itachi. Sasuke and Itachi have a chance to spend some time alone when their parents are away. Meanwhile, Sakura is very shy and tends to spend her free time by herself. One day, her new friend Ino gives her a present.

episodes.title: Gaara and Shikamaru
episodes.overview: A young Gaara is hated by his father and isolated by his siblings, who play in the sandbox with Gaara until their father separates them. During dinner, Gaara asks his uncle about his mother and how to feel happy. His uncle replies that the moon makes him feel better when he is sad, and Gaara agrees that the moon makes him feel happy. A young Shikamaru is bored in class lectures and wants to sleep but is punished along with Naruto and Choji by Iruka for interrupting class. They bond as they stand in the hallway and later hang out after school. Shikamaru criticises Naruto for defending Hinata from bullies and the boys later laugh at Ino for getting rejected by Sasuke.

episodes.title: Jiraiya and Kakashi
episodes.overview: Ever since he was young, Jiraiya has been a little pervy. He tries to involve Orochimaru in many of his exploits as well as his schemes to get Tsunade’s attention. In Kakashi's story, we see him living on his own since his father, Sakumo, died. Rin and Obito are fascinated by Kakashi, but his aloofness makes him hard to figure out.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story, Sunrise, Part 1: The Exploding Human
episodes.overview: "The fourth Great Shinobi World War has ended. But Sasuke decides to continue his solitary journey—this time to atone for his sins. Meanwhile, back at the Leaf Village, there is a growing number of missing shinobi. As Kakashi—the sixth Hokage—and the others discuss these incidents, the Leaf is attacked by a mysterious group of shinobi."

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story, Sunrise, Part 2: Colosseum
episodes.overview: Instead of returning to the Hidden Leaf, Sasuke sets out with Chino and Nowaki to investigate the cause of the exploding humans.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story, Sunrise, Part 3: Fūshin
episodes.overview: Orochimaru brings Sasuke to the Coliseum fighting ring, to lure out En Oyashiro, who may have some information regarding the Exploding Human incident. The match is called off when more Exploding Humans appear and the opportunity to meet Oyashiro seems lost. However, impressed by Sasuke’s Sharingan, Oyashiro approaches him in person.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story, Sunrise, Part 4: The Ketsuryūgan
episodes.overview: Sasuke uncovers Fuushin’s true identity at last, and begins to fight him. The moment Sasuke tries to read Fuushin’s memories with his Sharingan, a wave of genjutsu from a massive red eye causes Sasuke to lose consciousness. He awakens to find himself alone, and sees tracks in the snow that indicate Fuushin has barely escaped alive.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story, Sunrise, Part 5: The Last One
episodes.overview: Sasuke begins his own investigation into the incidents. He overcomes many dangers on his path to the truth. The Exploding Humans, the Ketsuryugan, the Chinoike Clan, and the Uchiha Clan—just how are they connected? Where does his journey lead? The mystery is about to be solved...

episodes.title: Shikamaru's Story, A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark, Part 1: The State of Affairs
episodes.overview: It’s been two years since the end of the Fourth Great Ninja War. Shikamaru now has an important role within the Hidden Leaf government, and as a representative of the Leaf in the Alliance. One day, a situation develops with shinobi disappearing in droves, and Shikamaru takes on a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Shikamaru's Story, A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark, Part 2: Dark Clouds
episodes.overview: After the Great War, many missing and Rogue Ninja made their way into the Land of Silence. Sai, who has infiltrated the region to investigate, sends a cryptic message back to the Leaf. Shikamaru, determined to find out what's happening, heads for the Land of Silence with two members of the ANBU, Soku and Ro. However, they must first get past a heavily guarded checkpoint.

episodes.title: Shikamaru's Story, A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark, Part 3: Recklessness
episodes.overview: Shikamaru and his team are within range of Fushu Castle, where Gengo is purported to be. But they are unable to glean any intel about the man. Learning that Gengo will make a public appearance, Shikamaru and company infiltrate the square, where they see Sai being held captive.

episodes.title: Shikamaru's Story, A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark, Part 4: Cloud of Suspicion
episodes.overview: Shikamaru is captured while trying to save Sai and stop Gengo. Far from giving up, he racks his brain to find a away out of the situation. Just as an opportunity presents itself, Ro and Soku appear under Gengo’s control!

episodes.title: Shikamaru's Story, A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark, Part 5: Dawn
episodes.overview: Ino, Choji, and Temari rush to Shikamaru’s aid! Choji takes on Ro, Temari goes after Soku, and Ino goes after Sai! Meanwhile, Shikamaru pursues Gengo. Can Shikamaru defeat Gengo’s evil ambitions? The final battle begins!

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 1: Naruto's Wedding
episodes.overview: Naruto and Hinata’s wedding day has been set. As the date approaches, Kakashi encounters a problem: Naruto’s friends are all top shinobi—the first line of defense in the village. They work 24/7, and there are always a few who cannot attend celebrations. As Kakashi tries to find the most reasonable solution, he announces a super-secret mission to find the couple a wedding gift.

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 2: A Full-Powered Wedding Gift
episodes.overview: Naruto and Hinata’s wedding day has been set. As the date approaches, Kakashi encounters a problem: Naruto’s friends are all top shinobi—the first line of defense in the village. They work 24/7, and there are always a few who cannot attend celebrations. As Kakashi tries to find the most reasonable solution, he announces a super-secret mission to find the couple a wedding gift.

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 3: Hot Springs and Food Pills
episodes.overview: The super-secret mission to find Naruto and Hinata a wedding gift proves to be difficult for Shikamaru. Choji has found the perfect gift, which adds to Shikamaru's panic. But then Choji mentions something in passing and Shikamaru gets an idea. All he needs now is to enlist Temari's help!

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 4: The Kazekage's Wedding Gift
episodes.overview: The Tsuchikage and Raikage, who are in the Leaf Village to attend the Five Kage Summit, mention that they have already prepared wedding gifts for Naruto. Gaara finds himself in a dilemma. He's advised that the gift should be something that befits the Kazekage. He also learns that the Raikage is planning to perform a dance. Kankuro chimes in and suggests Gaara should dance as well—further plunging Gaara into indecision.

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 5: The Last Mission
episodes.overview: Shino and Kiba still don't have a wedding gift for Hinata's wedding. Kiba's made it his goal to become the next Hokage, but unlike his teammates, who are steadfastly chasing their dreams, Shino is unsure about his. With this uncertainty, he sets out with Kiba and Akamaru on their final mission as Team 8!

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 6: The Outcome of the Secret Mission!
episodes.overview: Naruto's wedding day approaches, and one by one, each of his friends is getting a gift ready. But the true purpose for this mission has not been revealed to anyone: the gifts will be judged to select who can attend the reception! Seeing the care and thought that went into each of the gifts, Kakashi begins to wonder if that's the right thing to do.

episodes.title: Hidden Leaf Story, The Perfect Day for a Wedding, Part 7: The Message
episodes.overview: Naruto had once lived a lonely existence, ostracized by everyone. But Iruka's words and his very presence have supported Naruto to this day. As Naruto's wedding nears, Iruka begins to lose sight of what he was to Naruto, and is unsure of what to say for his message.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.overview: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands—the power of the Death Note. He decides to rid the world of evil—by killing off criminals one by one. When the murders start to pile up, genius detective L is on the case, and an epic battle of wits unfolds.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.overview: While the world’s criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations. He requests that a task force be set up in Japan, under the direction of none other than Soichiro Yagami, Light’s father.

episodes.title: Dealings
episodes.overview: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail. Light is troubled that he can’t find out the identity of his tracker, and Ryuk suggests an amazing deal...

episodes.title: Pursuit
episodes.overview: Light—now known to the world as Kira—tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways—and confirms he can control his victims’ actions before they die.

episodes.title: Tactics
episodes.overview: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan. Light, meanwhile, has found a way to get those very FBI agents off the case—permanently...

episodes.title: Unraveling
episodes.overview: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force. As son of the chief investigator, Light listens to her story, and is startled to discover she may have information that could lead to his arrest.

episodes.title: Overcast
episodes.overview: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn’t work. Realizing she must have given him an alias, he’s only got minutes to find out her real name before she tells her story to the task force.

episodes.title: Glare
episodes.overview: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura—whom Raye Penber was tracking. But Light is a step ahead as usual—he knows he’s being watched.

episodes.title: Encounter
episodes.overview: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light’s too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own. In order to get closer to Light, L enrolls at the same university and reveals himself to be L.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.overview: L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation. But then a phone call alerts them that Soichiro Yagami has suffered a heart attack!

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.overview: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one. On further investigation, L concludes that this Kira is not the original—there's a second Kira!

episodes.title: Love
episodes.overview: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat. Light agrees, hoping to divert suspicion from himself. To his surprise, this new Kira has a special ability even Light lacks…

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.overview: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious. But Misa Amane, the new Kira, uses her unusual gift to find Light before he finds her.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.overview: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L. But Misa asks something of Light in return—to fall in love with her!

episodes.title: Wager
episodes.overview: Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira. In an effort to spare her, Rem forces Misa to forfeit her ownership of the Death Note.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.overview: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away. When Light is confined as well, the murders stop and suspicion of Light grows stronger. Then suddenly, the killings resume.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.overview: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released. But L has devised a plan to ensure no more murders occur, and has Light's father, Soichiro, take the two for a ride that may be their last.

episodes.title: Ally
episodes.overview: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters, where Light notices a strange connection between the recent Kira killings and the Yotsuba Group.

episodes.title: Matsuda
episodes.overview: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself, and while on a job with Misa, he decides to do a little snooping on his own at the Yotsuba Group’s Tokyo headquarters.

episodes.title: Makeshift
episodes.overview: L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company, and concludes that Kira must be one of the eight executives. Can Light posing as L ferret out the right one?

episodes.title: Performance
episodes.overview: The Task Force uses Misa as a way to get closer to the Yotsuba corporation. But things get complicated when Rem tries to communicate with her.

episodes.title: Guidance
episodes.overview: Thanks to Misa, the Task Force now knows the identity of the new Kira and L plans an elaborate scheme to smoke him out of hiding.

episodes.title: Frenzy
episodes.overview: L, Light and Misa watch from the investigation team building and wonder who he is talking to. L wonders if Higuchi is talking to a shinigami. Rem convinces Higuchi to go to the station, but she has her own selfish motives for doing so.

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.overview: While Higuchi is finally captured, Light inadvertently regains his memories as Kira.

episodes.title: Silence
episodes.overview: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies. The Shinigami Rem realizes that everything is going according to Light's plan, and that L will arrest Misa as Kira-unless Rem acts quickly.

episodes.title: Renewal
episodes.overview: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

episodes.title: Abduction
episodes.overview: A new investigator steps forward-Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L. Near is aware of the existence of the Death Notes and wants to get his hands on one.

episodes.title: Impatience
episodes.overview: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note. Near finds out that the trade will happen in Los Angeles and promises to help, while secretly planning to steal the Death Note and capture Kira.

episodes.title: Father
episodes.overview: Mortified over allowing the Death Note to fall into Mello's hands in order to save his daughter, Soichiro puts himself into harm's way in order to get it back.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.overview: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira. In exchange for Near giving him the picture, Mello drops an important hint about the Death Notes: some of the rules are fake.

episodes.title: Transfer
episodes.overview: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members. He asks for insider information, and Aizawa, beginning to doubt Light, responds. Near suspects that the new L is really Light Yagami and that Light is Kira.

episodes.title: Selection
episodes.overview: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world, after Demegawa is deleted by Mikami, and she just so happens to have been Light's girlfriend in college. Aizawa's suspicions about Light grow.

episodes.title: Scorn
episodes.overview: Near goes to Japan, allegedly as bait for Kira. Following Light's instructions, Takada asks Mikami to send her five pages of the Death Note. She tells him that he will continue his work in a fake book made to look like the real one.

episodes.title: Vigilance
episodes.overview: Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes. Near instructs Aizawa to continue watching Light, and then puts in motion a plan to separate Misa from Light.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.overview: Light and Near agree upon a meeting place for the final confrontation. A key player is kidnapped and the end results are shocking.
The Japanese Task Force and the SPK finally meet at YellowBox Warehouse on January 28th. However, a third party has come to the warehouse as well, on Kira's orders to kill everyone else there.

episodes.title: New World
episodes.overview: Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive. Near seizes Mikami's Death Note, and all is at last revealed.

seasonDetails.name: Season 1
seasonDetails.overview: For his entire life, Izuku has dreamed of being a hero—an ambitious goal for anyone, but an especially challenging one for a boy without superpowers. That’s right: in a world where 80% of the population has some sort of special Gift, Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that won’t stop him from enrolling in one of the most prestigious hero academies in the world to learn what it truly means to be a hero.

seasonDetails.name: Season 2
seasonDetails.overview: U.A. High School's most prestigious event begins: the Sports Festival, an opportunity for aspiring heroes to showcase their skills to both the public and potential recruiters. However, the path to glory is never easy, especially for Izuku Midoriya, who must now face off against his talented classmates to prove his worth to the world.

seasonDetails.name: Season 3
seasonDetails.overview: Summer is here and the heroes of Rooms A and B are in for the toughest training camp of their lives! A group of seasoned professionals will push the students individualities to the next level with one new challenge after another. Braving the elements of this secret location will be the least of their worries as routine training turns into a grueling fight for survival.

seasonDetails.name: Season 4
seasonDetails.overview: With All for One out of the game, the evil world is on the brink of war. Shigaraki of the League of Villains and Overhaul of the Yakuza vie for dominance of the underworld. Meanwhile, Deku finds himself in another dangerous internship with his senior Mirio.

seasonDetails.name: Season 5
seasonDetails.overview: Deku's next challenge, in order to become the "best hero," is a rivalry with Class 1-B, who also intend to prove that they are true heroes, with all their pride on the line! The students' morale is boosted by a direct confrontation that hasn't occurred since the sports festival. Meanwhile, a new "something" is about to awaken within Deku.

seasonDetails.name: Season 6
seasonDetails.overview: Along with Bakugo and Todoroki, Deku interned at the office of the No. 1 Hero, Endeavor. Working hard in an environment rich in lessons, he improved as a hero and used Black Whip, a new Quirk that was hidden within One For All.

seasonDetails.name: Season 7
seasonDetails.overview: Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—the strongest woman on the planet, Star and Stripe. However, All For One decides to intercept Star and her fleet to get his hands on her overpowered quirk before she can enter Japanese airspace. Although Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist are headed to the rendezvous point, Star makes a gamble in the present to save her comrades.

seasonDetails.name: FINAL SEASON
seasonDetails.overview: Deku and the heroes are plunged into a final battle against villains across Japan. Deku, by fully unleashing One For All Quirks, faces off against Shigaraki. A young and refreshed All For One faces Armored All Might, Quirkless in his powered armor suit. Will Deku be able to bring the story of how they all became the greatest heroes to its finale? Or will everything be destroyed?!

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
episodes.overview: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might’s secret, but there’s trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Roaring Muscles
episodes.overview: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes.title: Start Line
episodes.overview: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes.title: What I Can Do for Now
episodes.overview: It’s Izuku’s first day of high school, and he still can’t control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes.title: Rage, You Damn Nerd
episodes.overview: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might…

episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes.title: Bakugo’s Start Line
episodes.overview: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes.title: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
episodes.overview: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes.title: Encounter with the Unknown
episodes.overview: Villains have attacked USJ, and it’s up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes.title: All Might
episodes.overview: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes.title: In Each of Our Hearts
episodes.overview: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

episodes.title: That’s the Idea, Ochaco
episodes.overview: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

episodes.title: Roaring Sports Festival
episodes.overview: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.

episodes.title: In Their Own Quirky Ways
episodes.overview: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

episodes.title: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
episodes.overview: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

episodes.title: Cavalry Battle Finale
episodes.overview: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

episodes.title: The Boy Born with Everything
episodes.overview: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

episodes.title: Victory or Defeat
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?

episodes.title: Battle on, Challengers!
episodes.overview: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?

episodes.title: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
episodes.overview: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

episodes.title: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!

episodes.title: Fight On, Iida
episodes.overview: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?

episodes.title: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
episodes.overview: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!

episodes.title: Time to Pick Some Names
episodes.overview: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!

episodes.title: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
episodes.overview: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

episodes.title: Midoriya and Shigaraki
episodes.overview: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

episodes.title: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
episodes.overview: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

episodes.title: Climax
episodes.overview: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

episodes.title: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
episodes.overview: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.

episodes.title: Everyone's Internships
episodes.overview: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

episodes.title: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
episodes.overview: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!

episodes.title: Gear up for Final Exams
episodes.overview: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

episodes.title: Yaoyorozu: Rising
episodes.overview: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

episodes.title: Stripping the Varnish
episodes.overview: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

episodes.title: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin
episodes.overview: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?

episodes.title: Encounter
episodes.overview: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.

episodes.title: Game Start
episodes.overview: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.

episodes.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
episodes.overview: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.

episodes.title: Kota
episodes.overview: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.

episodes.title: My Hero
episodes.overview: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

episodes.title: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!
episodes.overview: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.

episodes.title: Roaring Upheaval
episodes.overview: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!

episodes.title: What a Twist!
episodes.overview: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.title: From Iida to Midoriya
episodes.overview: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…

episodes.title: All For One
episodes.overview: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

episodes.title: Symbol of Peace
episodes.overview: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

episodes.title: One For All
episodes.overview: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

episodes.title: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.title: Moving into Dorms
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.

episodes.title: Create Those Ultimate Moves
episodes.overview: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.

episodes.title: The Test
episodes.overview: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

episodes.title: Shiketsu High Lurking
episodes.overview: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?

episodes.title: Class 1-A
episodes.overview: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

episodes.title: RUSH!
episodes.overview: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!

episodes.title: Rescue Exercises
episodes.overview: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

episodes.title: Special Episode: Save the World with Love!
episodes.overview: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!

episodes.title: What’s the Big Idea?
episodes.overview: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

episodes.title: A Talk about Your Quirk
episodes.overview: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
episodes.overview: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

episodes.title: A Season for Encounters
episodes.overview: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

episodes.title: Unrivaled
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

episodes.title: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A
episodes.overview: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

episodes.title: Overhaul
episodes.overview: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

episodes.title: Boy Meets…
episodes.overview: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…

episodes.title: Fighting Fate
episodes.overview: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.

episodes.title: Let’s Go, Gutsy Red Riot
episodes.overview: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.

episodes.title: An Unpleasant Talk
episodes.overview: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

episodes.title: GO!!
episodes.overview: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.

episodes.title: Suneater of the Big Three
episodes.overview: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

episodes.title: Red Riot
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

episodes.title: Temp Squad
episodes.overview: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.

episodes.title: Lemillion
episodes.overview: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…

episodes.title: Unforeseen Hope
episodes.overview: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…

episodes.title: Infinite 100%
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

episodes.title: Bright Future
episodes.overview: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…

episodes.title: Smoldering Flames
episodes.overview: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

episodes.title: Win Those Kids’ Hearts
episodes.overview: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

episodes.title: Relief for License Trainees
episodes.overview: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…

episodes.title: School Festival
episodes.overview: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

episodes.title: Prepping for the School Festival Is the Most Fun Part
episodes.overview: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.

episodes.title: Gold Tips Imperial
episodes.overview: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal
episodes.overview: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…

episodes.title: School Festival Start!!
episodes.overview: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.

episodes.title: Let It Flow! School Festival!
episodes.overview: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

episodes.title: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart
episodes.overview: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

episodes.title: His Start
episodes.overview: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.

episodes.title: All Hands on Deck! Class 1-A
episodes.overview: There's an emergency drill at U.A. High School, and Class 1-A is requested to report for duty!

episodes.title: Vestiges
episodes.overview: After their fight with the Nomu, Hawks and Endeavor return to daily life, and Izuku dreams of One For All…

episodes.title: Clash! Class A vs. Class B!
episodes.overview: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

episodes.title: Make It Happen, Shinso!
episodes.overview: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

episodes.title: Operation New Improv Moves
episodes.overview: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles!

episodes.title: Foresight
episodes.overview: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

episodes.title: Match 3
episodes.overview: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

episodes.title: Match 3 Conclusion
episodes.overview: It's still anybody's game as the the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

episodes.title: Early Bird!
episodes.overview: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

episodes.title: That Which Is Inherited
episodes.overview: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

episodes.title: Our Brawl
episodes.overview: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish!

episodes.title: The New Power and All For One
episodes.overview: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

episodes.title: Have a Merry Christmas!
episodes.overview: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

episodes.title: Off to Endeavor's Agency!
episodes.overview: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

episodes.title: One Thing at a Time
episodes.overview: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work study students with the next steps in their training.

episodes.title: Long Time No See, Selkie
episodes.overview: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

episodes.title: The Hellish Todoroki Family
episodes.overview: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

episodes.title: The Unforgiven
episodes.overview: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

episodes.title: More of a Hero Than Anyone
episodes.overview: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

episodes.title: My Villain Academia
episodes.overview: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

episodes.title: Revival Party
episodes.overview: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

episodes.title: Sad Man's Parade
episodes.overview: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

episodes.title: Tenko Shimura: Origin
episodes.overview: Memories from Shigaraki's past as Tenko Shimura resurface as he confronts Re-Destro.

episodes.title: Tomura Shigaraki: Origin
episodes.overview: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

episodes.title: The High, Deep Blue Sky
episodes.overview: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

episodes.title: A Quiet Beginning
episodes.overview: Using the information Hawks gathered, the heroes and their work study students get ready for an attack on the Paranormal Liberation Front led by Shigaraki.

episodes.title: Mirko, the No. 5 Hero
episodes.overview: As Endeavor and the others fight the Nomus at the hospital, Mirko goes against Kyudai Garaki's best soldiers, the High-Ends. Meanwhile, Kaminari steels his resolve to save those he cares about and goes to the front line of team Edgeshot.

episodes.title: One's Justice
episodes.overview: Inside Gunga Villa, the Paranormal Liberation Front realizes that they are under attack, and Twice confronts Hawks about his betrayal.

episodes.title: Inheritance
episodes.overview: An enraged Dabi confronts Hawks after Twice's death, meanwhile at the Hospital Endeavor, Eraser head, Crust, Present Mic and X-less finally arrive to help Mirko, who's risking her life to stop Shigaraki's awakening.

episodes.title: The Thrill of Destruction
episodes.overview: The fight against the High-End Nomus in Jaku Hospital continues however they are unaware that Tomura Shigaraki has awakened. Whilst this is happening, Tokoyami flies in to try and save Hawks from Dabi.

episodes.title: Encounter, Part 2
episodes.overview: Gigantomachia and the rest of the Paranormal Liberation Front gain the upper hand at the Gunga Mountain Villa as the newly awakened Tomura Shigaraki finds a new objective; steal One for All from Izuku Midoriya.

episodes.title: Disaster Walker
episodes.overview: The fight against Shigaraki continues while other heroes fight the new Nomus that Shigaraki summoned. While this is happening Team Edgeshot tries to stop Gigantomachia from making it to Jaku City.

episodes.title: League of Villains vs. U.A. Students
episodes.overview: The pro heroes' defensive net was broken through. Facing the monstrous giant are the U.A. hero course students. Class A and Class B work together to start a big operation to block Gigantomachia.

episodes.title: Katsuki Bakugo: Rising
episodes.overview: As Aizawa seems to be out of the battle, Midoriya tries to keep Shigaraki in the air utilizing all of his quirks. Knowing his limit is near, Bakugo comes up with a plan to help him.

episodes.title: The Ones Within Us
episodes.overview: Shigaraki's attack pierced right through Kacchan. Deku loses himself to his rage and thrust himself to Shigaraki. However, things change suddenly. In the world of One For All, Deku stand against Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes.title: Dabi's Dance
episodes.overview: As Ochaco and Toga exchange words and blows, Gigantomachia reaches Shigaraki and the heroes, and Dabi reveals the secret of his past.

episodes.title: Threads of Hope
episodes.overview: Best Jeanist appears and spins together the hopes of all the heroes in this fight as the climax of the all-out war draws near.

episodes.title: Final Performance
episodes.overview: Thinking of his great-great-grandfather, Mr. Compress performs his greatest trick in order to save the League of Villains.

episodes.title: Hellish Hell
episodes.overview: The heroes wrestle with changing public opinion as they deal with the aftermath of the fierce battle and mourn those they lost in the fight.

episodes.title: Tartarus
episodes.overview: Under All For One's control, Shigaraki attacks Tartarus with the Nomus to free All For One's body, freeing many other prisoners in the process.

episodes.title: The Hellish Todoroki Family, Part 2
episodes.overview: As heroes deal with criticism from the public, Hawks thinks back on his past with his family, and Endeavor's family visits him in the hospital.

episodes.title: The Wrong Way to Put Out a Fire
episodes.overview: Endeavor and his family reflect on Toya's past and the events that led to his death, and Hawks and Best Jeanist bring them a proposition.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya and Tomura Shigaraki
episodes.overview: Inside One For All, Izuku talks with the past wielders as the top three heroes deal with public sentiment after Dabi's revelation.

episodes.title: Full Power!!
episodes.overview: After Izuku decides not to go back to U.A., he finds himself facing Muscular, who was broken out of jail, again and uses the Quirks of the past wielders against him.

episodes.title: Hired Gun
episodes.overview: The top three heroes continue to face criticism as they deal with jailbreakers and look for hints about All For One and Shigaraki's whereabouts, and Izuku comes across a villain from Tartarus.

episodes.title: The Lovely Lady Nagant
episodes.overview: During Izuku's fight with Lady Nagant, she tells him secrets about hero society that further solidify his resolve to help those who need his help.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.overview: As Izuku goes off alone in his quest for justice, his classmates realize something is wrong and try to find a way to help him.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Class A
episodes.overview: As Deku tries to run away, Class A draws him back by recounting their memories with him and reminding him of his own words.

episodes.title: A Young Woman's Declaration
episodes.overview: As the evacuees at U.A. voice their dissent, Ochaco speaks up to try and sway them. Onlookers with ties to Izuku try to figure out if it's time for them to speak out, too.

episodes.title: No Man Is an Island
episodes.overview: As Izuku tries to rest and recover back at U.A. with his classmates, All Might has an encounter with Stain that leads to new information about Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes.title: In the Nick of Time! A Big-Time Maverick from the West
episodes.overview: As jailbreakers run rampant in Japan, Star and Stripe flies from the U.S. to Japan to help and finds Shigaraki waiting for her in the middle of her flight path.

episodes.title: Specter
episodes.overview: The fight between Star and Stripe and Shigaraki is coming to an end, but Star has one more trick up her sleeve with New Order.

episodes.title: Villain
episodes.overview: After failing to steal Star's Quirk, New Order, and losing many other Quirks, Shigaraki and All For One prepare for their next move. Who is the traitor at U.A.?!

episodes.title: The Story of How We All Became Heroes
episodes.overview: Due to his relationship with All For One, Yuga Aoyama calls himself a villain, but Deku tells him that he can still be a hero and reaches a hand out to him.

episodes.title: Let You Down
episodes.overview: As heroes and villains get ready for the coming battle, Deku and the others leave U.A., and Deku is called out by Aoyama, who is supposed to be in a police cell. What does Aoyama want?

episodes.title: Division
episodes.overview: It's finally time for the decisive battle between heroes and villains! The plan by All Might, Aizawa, and the others has them start their fights in various places around Japan!

episodes.title: Inflation
episodes.overview: Even though Shigaraki's Quirks are sealed, he attacks Bakugo and the others with a strange new appearance and power. Meanwhile, Deku is pulled to where Toga was warped and Todoroki and Dabi face off!

episodes.title: Two Flashfires
episodes.overview: Eleven years ago, Toya Todoroki was burned by his own flames and became Dabi. Todoroki faces Dabi's blue flames with a new move of his own. Will he be able to stop his brother?

episodes.title: Extras
episodes.overview: Shoto Todoroki stopped Dabi with his Great Glacial Aegir, and reports of that bolstered the spirits of the heroes fighting in other locations. And Shoto and Dabi's father, Endeavor, is facing the greatest evil, All For One, with Hawks!

episodes.title: Wounded Hero, Burning Bright and True!!
episodes.overview: Before the threat of All For One, Endeavor falls, and Hawks, Jiro, and Tokoyami are also cornered. Even so, Jiro acts like a hero! Endeavor is also encouraged after looking back at his own life.

episodes.title: Light Fades to Rain
episodes.overview: Bakugo's Howitzer Impact didn't work against Shigaraki/All For One, either, and Bakugo is pushed into a corner by Shigaraki's power and words. In order to get him out of that predicament, U.A.'s Big Three take a stand!

episodes.title: Those Who Defend, Those Who Violate
episodes.overview: Bakugo surprised Shigaraki/All For One with Cluster but was then cruelly pierced through. The heroes in all the different locations are getting pushed back... But even so, they will not give up!

episodes.title: A Chain of Events, Across the Ages
episodes.overview: Deku finally arrives at the Coffin in the Sky! Seeing Bakugo and the others defeated by Shigaraki/All For One, Deku shakes with anger. Can he control his feelings and win against Shigaraki? It's finally time for a showdown!

episodes.title: Together with Shoji
episodes.overview: Spinner takes heteromorphs who are exploding with resentment from being persecuted to Central Hospital to get Kurogiri back. Shoji, whose Quirk also makes him a heteromorph, shouts his feelings to them.

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect
episodes.overview: Spinner and Present Mic both yell their hearts out. Will the one waking up to their voices be Kurogiri, or Shirakumo? Meanwhile, fighting Ochaco and the others on Okuto Island, Toga is finally going to use her secret weapon...!

episodes.title: The Chain Thus Far
episodes.overview: Toga consumed Twice's blood, and with Kurogiri's Warp, infinite doubles of Twice appear. Shigaraki's Decay is also released, and the heroes seem to be in a state of despair. But then, help comes from an unexpected quarter...

episodes.title: Hopes
episodes.overview: With the addition of Gentle, La Brava, and Lady Nagant, Deku is able to restrain Shigaraki's hands and confront him on the ground. Meanwhile, at the Gunga Villa site, the rewound All For One shows off his awful power...

episodes.title: It's a Small World
episodes.overview: Shishikura and the other members of Shiketsu High join the fight at the Gunga Villa site, and it's do-or-die as the heroes unite to fight back! But as All For One gets younger, he gets stronger. That's when unexpected backup arrives...!

episodes.title: I Am Here
episodes.overview: Trampling the heroes, All For One flies to become one with Shigaraki, and Dabi is about to explode with the heat he's been storing up in his body. Will the Symbol be able change this hopeless situation?

episodes.title: A Girl's Ego
episodes.overview: Toga transforms into Twice and backs the heroes into a corner with Infinite Doubles. In the midst of that, Ochaco does her best to get close to Toga to talk to her. How does Toga respond...?

episodes.title: Battle Without a Quirk
episodes.overview: Toga returns the smile of Ochaco, who tried to be friends with her. What does Toga do to the seriously-injured Ochaco? Meanwhile, All Might uses "power" developed by a friend to face All For One!

episodes.title: Toshinori Yagi: Rising/Origin
episodes.overview: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

episodes.title: The End of an Era, and the Beginning
episodes.overview: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.

episodes.title: The Final Boss!!
episodes.overview: Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?

episodes.title: Quirk: Explosion!!
episodes.overview: The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.

episodes.title: History's Greatest Villain
episodes.overview: The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.

episodes.title: Wrench It Open, Izuku Midoriya!!
episodes.overview: Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.

episodes.title: From Aizawa
episodes.overview: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya: Rising
episodes.overview: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

episodes.title: Epilogue, The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
episodes.overview: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
episodes.overview: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

episodes.title: My Hero Academia
episodes.overview: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

seasonDetails.name: Season 1
seasonDetails.overview: Saitama is a hero who only became a hero for fun. After three years of “special” training, though, he’s become so strong that he’s practically invincible. In fact, he’s too strong—even his mightiest opponents are taken out with a single punch, and it turns out that being devastatingly powerful is actually kind of a bore. With his passion for being a hero lost along with his hair, yet still faced with new enemies every day, how much longer can he keep it going?

seasonDetails.name: Season 2
seasonDetails.overview: Saitama, alongside his cyborg disciple Genos, is ready to begin his official duties as a professional hero. But when a new friendship and interest in martial arts prove distracting, the Hero Association is left to deal with a sinister new wave of monster attacks on their own. To make matters worse, their heroes are being hunted! Is Earth doomed, or will Saitama save the day with one punch?

seasonDetails.name: Season 3
seasonDetails.overview: Alongside Genos, his faithful disciple, Saitama performs his official hero duties as a member of the Hero Association. One day, monsters claiming to be from the Monster Association suddenly appeared, taking a child of the Hero Association executive hostage. The S-class heroes gather and plan a raid on the Monster Association hideout to rescue the hostage. Meanwhile, Garou, a “human monster” who was taken by the Monster Association during a battle with the heroes, awakens in the Monster Association hideout.

episodes.title: The Strongest Man
episodes.overview: Saitama is a guy who’s a hero for fun. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years. Though he’s now so strong he can defeat any opponent with a single punch, lately he feels as if, in exchange for overwhelming power, he’s lost something even more important.

episodes.title: The Lone Cyborg
episodes.overview: A monster is moving toward City Z, one that has been created by the mysterious organization known as The House of Evolution. Genos, a young cyborg, attempts to stop it, but gets in over his head before Saitama happens along.

episodes.title: The Obsessive Scientist
episodes.overview: Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder Dr. Genus, a scientist with dangerous ideas on artificial human evolution. Meanwhile, Dr. Genus learns of Saitama’s amazing strength and has plans of his own for One-Punch Man.

episodes.title: The Modern Ninja
episodes.overview: A group of battlesuit-clad terrorists called “The Paradisers” appears in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead. Calling for the redistribution of wealth, the group targets the fat-cat Zeniru, who in turn dispatches his bodyguard to defeat them. Unfortunately, Saitama is on the same errand.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Master
episodes.overview: Though he’s been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him. Determined to get a little recognition, he decides to become a pro hero, but first he must pass the Hero Association tests and become a full-fledged member.

episodes.title: The Terrifying City
episodes.overview: It’s been five days since Saitama became a professional hero and he has yet to do anything heroic. When Genos informs him that C-class heroes who don’t fight bad guys are dropped from the hero registry after a week of inaction, Saitama heads out on patrol, yet can’t find any criminals or monsters to stop.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Disciple
episodes.overview: An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z, forcing the Hero Association to ask its S Class heroes to respond. When all their efforts prove in vain, Genos decides it’s up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.

episodes.title: The Deep Sea King
episodes.overview: A pack of monsters calling themselves the “Clan of the Seafolk” arrive on the shores of City J intent on invading the land. When the hero sent to fight them is defeated easily by the Deep Sea King himself, Saitama and Genos head for the city to help.

episodes.title: Unyielding Justice
episodes.overview: As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot’s brutal attacks. Which of them has what it takes to be a true hero?

episodes.title: Unparalleled Peril
episodes.overview: Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth. Though the crisis could occur anytime in the next six months, the heroes are surprised to hear the roar of explosions that very hour!

episodes.title: The Dominator of the Universe
episodes.overview: As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S Class heroes. Despite their powers, they can’t seem to finish it off. Meanwhile, Saitama has boarded the enemy ship on his own.

episodes.title: The Strongest Hero
episodes.overview: The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama! With the fate of humanity in the balance, will the two champions at last find in each other the worthy opponent they’ve been searching for?

episodes.title: Return of the Hero
episodes.overview: Saitama is out shopping with Genos in tow when the pair come across G4, a demonic robot on a mission to eliminate King. Elsewhere, Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.

episodes.title: Human Monster
episodes.overview: Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association through terrifying means, Hellish Blizzard gives Saitama an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master's stalker, Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

episodes.title: The Hunt Begins
episodes.overview: Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S Class hero Tank-top Master. Meanwhile, Silverfang shutters his dojo to begin his own hunt of his former disciple.

episodes.title: Metal Bat
episodes.overview: Assigned to guard a VIP and his son, Metal Bat couldn't be less thrilled. But when the group is suddenly attacked all hell breaks loose. Meanwhile, Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.

episodes.title: Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.overview: Monsters from the Monster Association launch simultaneous attacks on all the human cities, attempting to overwhelm the forces of the Hero Association. Meanwhile, the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament kicks off.

episodes.title: The Uprising of the Monsters
episodes.overview: The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C. Elsewhere, countless monsters are wreaking havoc in multiple areas, but the Hero Association is being overwhelmed by the sheer number of threats.

episodes.title: Class S Heroes
episodes.overview: As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions. Meanwhile, Atomic Samurai is setting in motion a plan of his own.

episodes.title: The Strong Ones Fight Back
episodes.overview: Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. Having now become a monster, he’s aiming to force the Super Fight competitors to turn into monsters themselves. When several do, it’s up to Suiryu to take them on alone.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Dilemma
episodes.overview: Just as Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair, Saitama suddenly appears to help him out. But despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t seem to shake.

episodes.title: The Encircling Net of Justice
episodes.overview: The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma. Elsewhere, Garou tries to recover from his constant fighting, but things don’t quite go as planned.

episodes.title: Everyone's Dignity
episodes.overview: Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit. The hero hunter still has his incredible ability to read opponents’ fighting styles, but there are surprises in store for all.

episodes.title: Cleaning Up the Disciple's Mess
episodes.overview: Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind battle that draws in more and more combatants as it marches towards its hair-raising climax!

episodes.title: Strategy Meeting
episodes.overview: The heroes plan a rescue of a child kidnapped by monsters, while Garou awakens deep underground.

episodes.title: Monster Traits
episodes.overview: On his way to hunt heroes, Garou dines and dashes at a restaurant, but is chased by Saitama.

episodes.title: Organism Limits
episodes.overview: Garou fights Insect God and King the Ripper, while Tareo gets kidnapped. Dr. Kuseno visits Saitama.

episodes.title: Counterattack Signal
episodes.overview: The heroes prepare for battle without Silverfang and Genos. Garou attacks the Monster Association.

episodes.title: Monster King
episodes.overview: Garou rescues Tareo but is struck by Overgrown Pochi, falling to Orochi and Gyoro-Gyoro.

episodes.title: Motley Heroes
episodes.overview: Class-S heroes plan the Monster Association assault, but Amai Mask arrives and clashes with them.

episodes.title: Counterstrike
episodes.overview: Heroes arrive in Z City but face a monster ambush. A-class aids while Gyoro-Gyoro watches the fight.

episodes.title: Ninja Tale
episodes.overview: Tempest Wind and Hellfire Flame, who were ninjas but are now monsters, battle with Flashy Flash.

episodes.title: Brave Child
episodes.overview: Child Emperor finds Waganma and faces Phoenix Man, using his ultimate weapon to protect him.

episodes.title: Immortal Bloodbath
episodes.overview: Zombieman faces Vampire, a descendant of a supernatural bloodline, in a brutal, deadly showdown.

episodes.title: Top Dragons
episodes.overview: Child Emperor rescues Waganma. The heroes take on threat-level Dragon monsters in a deadly fight.

episodes.title: Ultimate Lifeform
episodes.overview: The heroes battle monsters while Terrible Tornado faces Gyoro-Gyoro. Orochi appears before Saitama.

seasonDetails.name: Thousand-Year Blood War
seasonDetails.overview: The final arc of the Bleach series, where Ichigo Kurosaki and the Soul Reapers face off against the powerful Quincy army, led by Yhwach, in a battle that threatens the balance of all worlds.

episodes.title: The Day I Became a Shinigami
episodes.overview: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

episodes.title: A Shinigami's Work
episodes.overview: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

episodes.title: The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
episodes.overview: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

episodes.title: Cursed Parakeet
episodes.overview: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

episodes.title: Beat the Invisible Enemy!
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

episodes.title: Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
episodes.overview: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

episodes.title: Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

episodes.title: June 17, Memories in the Rain
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

episodes.title: Unbeatable Enemy
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

episodes.title: Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
episodes.overview: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

episodes.title: The Legendary Quincy
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

episodes.title: A Gentle Right Arm
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

episodes.title: Flower and Hollow
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

episodes.title: Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

episodes.title: Kon's Great Plan
episodes.overview: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
episodes.overview: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

episodes.title: Ichigo Dies!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

episodes.title: Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
episodes.overview: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

episodes.title: Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
episodes.overview: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Enter! The World of the Shinigami
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter Soul Society.

episodes.title: The Man who Hates Shinigami
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are forced to find another way into Seireitei due to 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru's intervention.

episodes.title: 14 Days Before Rukia's Execution
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the household of the Shiba Clan.

episodes.title: Assemble! The 13 Divisions
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin their preparations to get into the Seireitei, the Gotei 13 captains assemble for a meeting.

episodes.title: Penetrate the Center with an Enormous Bombshell?
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Formation! The Worst Tag
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are scattered throughout the Seireitei, where they encounter new enemies.

episodes.title: Release the Death Blow!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki completes his battle with 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame while his friends continue to progress through the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Orihime Targeted
episodes.overview: Ganju Shiba wins his battle against 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa while Uryū Ishida begins his own.

episodes.title: Breakthrough! The Shinigami's Encompassing Net
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida defeats 7th Division 4th Seat Jirōbō Ikkanzaka while Ichigo Kurosaki and Ganju Shiba encounter 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada, who personally knows Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Renji's Confrontation
episodes.overview: Having been led to the base of Senzaikyū, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his rematch with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai.

episodes.title: The Resolution to Kill
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai conclude their rematch.

episodes.title: Stars and the Stray
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai remembers his past with Rukia Kuchiki and begs Ichigo Kurosaki to save her in his stead.

episodes.title: Miracle! The Mysterious New Hero
episodes.overview: In the Human World, Yuzu Kurosaki finds a cat named Raku and is drawn into an adventure with Don Kanonji and his Karakura-Raizer Team.

episodes.title: Tragedy of Dawn
episodes.overview: As the Gotei 13 reacts to 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai's defeat, Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto declares war against the Ryoka.

episodes.title: Aizen Assassinated! The Darkness which Approaches
episodes.overview: While the Gotei 13 deals with the death of 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen, Ichigo Kurosaki and his group attempt to enter Senzaikyū once again.

episodes.title: Zaraki Kenpachi Approaches!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: Motive of the Fist
episodes.overview: Yasutora Sado battles with 8th Division captain, Shunsui Kyōraku.

episodes.title: Desperation! The Broken Zangetsu
episodes.overview: As the high-ranking members of the Gotei 13 continue to react to 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen's murder, Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: The Immortal Man
episodes.overview: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: The Shinigami whom Ganju Met
episodes.overview: While 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi reminisces about her history with her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada reach Rukia Kuchiki's cell in Senzaikyū.

episodes.title: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the White Tower and reunites with Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Yoruichi, Goddess of Flash, Dances!
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin saves Ichigo Kurosaki and decides to help him attain Bankai.

episodes.title: The Despicable Shinigami
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida and Orihime Inoue are confronted by 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.title: Ishida Ultimate Power!
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida removes his Sanrei Glove to defeat 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.title: Overcome Your Limits!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his Bankai Training.

episodes.title: Authentic Records! School of Shinigami
episodes.overview: 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori recalls her past at the Shin'ō Academy.

episodes.title: The Avengers
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his Bankai Training, 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori confronts 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya over the contents of the letter left by her captain, Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Roars!
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru.

episodes.title: Rukia's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba.

episodes.title: The Reviving Lion
episodes.overview: The Karakura Superheroes come together once more and fight a Hollow.

episodes.title: Morning of the Sentence
episodes.overview: As the day of Rukia Kuchiki's execution arrives, various groups around the Seireitei move out and clash with one another.

episodes.title: Renji, Oath of the Soul! Death Match with Byakuya
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai battles his captain, Byakuya Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Ichimaru Gin's Temptation, Resolution Shattered
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his subordinates battle the 7th and 9th Division captains and lieutenants.

episodes.title: An Accomplished Oath! Get back Rukia!
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki's execution ceremony commences, but does not proceed as planned.

episodes.title: The Strongest Shinigami! Ultimate Confrontation Between Teacher and Students
episodes.overview: After the interruption of Rukia Kuchiki's execution, battles commence all across the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Supersonic Battle! Determine the Goddess of Battle
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin battles 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng.

episodes.title: Senbonzakura, Crushed! Zangetsu Thrusts through the Sky
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue their battle.

episodes.title: Unseal! The Black Blade, the Miraculous Power
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki activate their Bankai.

episodes.title: Conclusion of the Death Match! White Pride and Black Desire
