episodes.overview: 35 forwards remain after the 2nd selection at Blue Lock. With a big match against Japan's U-20s in three weeks, Ego announces that the team will be centered around the top 6 players. The tryouts for the rest of the positions begin.

episodes.title: The Assassin and the Ninja
episodes.overview: Isagi is chosen as Team A1 along with Nanase and Hiori to play against Team B1, which includes Karasu, Otoya, and Chigiri. While Isagi struggles to find a way into the game, Chigiri and Hiori demonstrate their worth.

episodes.title: The World You Feel
episodes.overview: Seeing how incompatible Rin and Shidou are, Isagi hopes to take advantage of it. However, his physical abilities are not enough to get him where he needs to be. Then, Hiori suggests that Isagi does the thinking "on reflex."

episodes.title: Chameleon
episodes.overview: Isagi looks back and analyzes what he did when he scored a goal on reflex. Then, when the second match begins, Reo finds his new playstyle: Chameleon.

episodes.title: FLOW
episodes.overview: The tryouts are complete, and Isagi is chosen for the starting lineup. But Shidou is nowhere to be seen... It turns out Sae has picked him to join the U-20s. Meanwhile, Ego begins the final training camp, where he discusses the secret of "flow."

episodes.title: The Big Stage
episodes.overview: The exhibition match between Blue Lock and Japan's U-20s has finally kicked off. The first play Bachira and Isagi set up has been swiftly shut down by the U-20s' captain, Aiku, and Isagi finds a new challenge in him.

episodes.title: Itoshi Sae
episodes.overview: When Itoshi Sae scores the first goal of the match, the crowd goes wild, making it clear to Team Blue Lock that they're here to watch Sae. Rin changes the strategy and Nagi makes the memorable first goal for Team Blue Lock.

episodes.title: Blue Genes
episodes.overview: Rin and Sae's sibling match goes to Sae as he takes the ball. But Niko, Karasu, Otoya, and Chigiri set up another goal chance, and Rin scores despite shooting on his non-dominant leg. At 1-2, the U-20s are finally ready to go all out.

episodes.title: Night Snow
episodes.overview: Isagi, Bachira, and Chigiri's families are happy to see their sons on the field. Meanwhile, we get a glimpse of what transpired between Rin and Sae. Sae is about to quit the match, but he decides to stay when Shidou is thrown into the fray.

episodes.title: The Subs Take to the Stage
episodes.overview: Shidou joins the match in the second half and throws everyone off with his crazy play. After he scores a free kick, Chigiri and Niko get swapped out with Reo and Hiori. With Blue Lock’s new formation, Reo proves his worth with Chameleon Defense.

episodes.title: What You Taught Us
episodes.overview: Shidou enters the "flow" and unleashes his Big Bang Drive to score another goal. Isagi demands that Ego let them win, and Ego subs Barou in to cause chaos on the field. And the other players start to find their "flow"...

episodes.title: Flowers
episodes.overview: As Aiku looks back on why he converted to a defender, the U-20s uses their specialty quick attack. Reo copies Nagi's skill to hold them off. Isagi yields the last step to Rin, which is stolen by Barou who has waited for the chance in the dark.

episodes.title: Not Alone
episodes.overview: Seeing the players' upgrade, Sae takes the play to the next level. In response, Rin starts to align his thought process to Sae and drastically changes his play style . Then Rin realizes that Blue Lock players have been keeping up with his play.

episodes.title: Last Attack
episodes.overview: Rin enters his "flow," and Isagi's faith in Rin's trance state pays off when Isagi applies what he's learned about the mechanism of luck back when he lost to Rin. Can the Blue Lock XI beat Japan's U-20s, and what awaits them after the match?

episodes.title: Mother and Children
episodes.overview: Stories are lies meant to entertain, and idols lie to fans eager to believe. This is Ai's story. It is a lie, but it is also true.

episodes.title: Third Option
episodes.overview: Ruby wants to be an idol for herself and for the little girl who died from cancer. The real world, however, doesn't care about big dreams: something Aqua knows all too well.

episodes.title: Manga-Based TV Drama
episodes.overview: Aqua agrees to Kana's request, but not for the reason she wants. There's a connection between Masaya Kaburagi and Ai, which leads Aqua to the set of a TV drama for answers.

episodes.title: Actors
episodes.overview: Kana's resolve remains strong despite her washed up reputation. Aqua sets the stage for her with a bold move that flips the script, which leads to opportunities for them both.

episodes.title: Reality Dating Show
episodes.overview: Despite different motivations, Aqua, Ruby and Kana’s key to success in the entertainment industry is the same; to achieve their goals, they need to play the game.

episodes.title: Egosurfing
episodes.overview: Remember what you said in righteous outrage online? There were consequences. You never saw them, but that didn't make them any less real, nor hold you any less accountable.

episodes.title: Buzz
episodes.overview: Left reeling in the immediate aftermath, Akane's costars unite in friendship and purpose: they will clear their friend's name. They owe her nothing less.

episodes.title: First Time
episodes.overview: Focused on revenge, Aqua underestimated Akane and gave the talented actress a way to win his heart. If love is a game, Akane is playing for keeps and Kana is falling behind.

episodes.title: B Komachi
episodes.overview: MEM-cho won't let her second chance go to waste and uses her influence to help grow B Komachi's brand. Meanwhile, Aqua's investigation into Ai's past bears fruit.

episodes.title: Pressure
episodes.overview: B Komachi's first performance approaches, but the group still needs practice while Kana refuses to be the center. Perhaps a certain expert choreographer could help them shine?

episodes.title: Idol
episodes.overview: MEM-cho has fans. Ruby has looks. But Kana has...? She’ll need to find the answer before she can be anyone's star. Later, a fresh opportunity sets Aqua on a new path to revenge.

episodes.title: Tokyo Blade
episodes.overview: The stage is set. The actors are ready. And the curtain rises on the play, Tokyo Blade. However, there is another story aside from the play: that of the actors themselves.

episodes.title: Game of Telephone
episodes.overview: The creator of Tokyo Blade isn’t happy with the unfaithful adaptation of her manga and demands a revision of the entire script. However, only twenty days remain until opening.

episodes.title: Rewriting
episodes.overview: Time is dwindling, and a question looms: a faithful Tokyo Blade adaptation or one tailored for theater? Amidst the tension, only one person can convince Abiko to compromise.

episodes.title: Emotional Acting
episodes.overview: Abiko and GOA collaborate on a new script and now the pressure is on the actors to bring the script to life. However, Aqua soon faces an unexpected challenge during rehearsal.

episodes.title: The Curtain Rises
episodes.overview: Aqua confides in Akane, revealing his true motives. She vows to remain by his side, but this deepening bond causes Akane’s rivalry with Kana to intensify.

episodes.title: Growth
episodes.overview: Melt regrets his poor acting in Sweet Today and vows to improve in Tokyo Blade. However, how can a subpar actor stand out among exceptional ones?

episodes.title: Sun
episodes.overview: Akane became an actress because she idolized Kana and wanted to be like her. However, one should never meet their heroes.

episodes.title: Trigger
episodes.overview: Their pasts shaped their acting. Kana wanted to shine as an actress, but she compromised to be useful. Meanwhile, Aqua’s childhood trauma led to a unique acting method.

episodes.title: Dream
episodes.overview: The actors shone brilliantly, and the curtain fell on a successful play, setting the stage for the next performance as Aqua and Taiki press the director for answers.

episodes.title: Liberation
episodes.overview: Taiki discovers a surprising connection, but reveals something Aqua wasn't expecting. Meanwhile, Ruby hopes one person in particular notices B Komachi's growing fame.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.overview: Aqua doesn't have to live for revenge and can finally look towards a brighter future. But what does this mean for the relationships he's cultivated in pursuit of a killer?

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: The past never truly disappears. Aqua and Ruby return to the place they were born… and where, in another life, they also died.

episodes.title: Wish
episodes.overview: A gruesome discovery finally gives Aqua the closure he needs to begin a new chapter in his life. But as he steps into a brighter tomorrow, Ruby’s descent into darkness begins.

episodes.title: Down Bad
episodes.overview: Six months have passed since the release of B-Komachi's music video, and lots of things have changed.

episodes.title: Calculating
episodes.overview: Ruby starts to make her mark as reporter on Dig Deep!

episodes.title: Correctness
episodes.overview: Things go horribly wrong at the Comiket shoot. Can Dig Deep come back from this?

episodes.title: Blind
episodes.overview: Aqua confronts Ruby and starts to piece together the puzzle.

episodes.title: Casting
episodes.overview: Kana's at the end of her rope and decides to try to get back into acting.

episodes.title: Idols and Relationships
episodes.overview: Kana's encounter with Shima looms over her and the rest of Strawberry Productions.

episodes.title: Breakdown
episodes.overview: Kana has bounced back, but the scandal still looms large.

episodes.title: Plan
episodes.overview: Aqua has to face the aftermath of his decision to reveal Ai's secret.

episodes.title: Greed and Passion
episodes.overview: As the movie project kicks into gear, Masaya Kaburagi goes to work, putting both sides of himself on show.

episodes.title: Private Audition
episodes.overview: How will Ruby and Akane act out the theme of liar? And how will the audition end?

episodes.title: The Beginning
episodes.overview: Aqua has a very surprising encounter, and Ruby is close to succumbing under all the pressure.

seasonDetails.name: Season 1
seasonDetails.overview: When high schooler Momo, from a family of spirit mediums, first meets her classmate Okarun, an occult geek, they argue—Momo believes in ghosts but denies aliens, and Okarun believes in aliens but denies ghosts. When it turns out both phenomena are real, Momo awakens a hidden power and Okarun gains the power of a curse. Together, they must challenge the paranormal forces threatening their world.

episodes.title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
episodes.overview: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

episodes.title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
episodes.overview: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

episodes.title: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!
episodes.overview: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

episodes.title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
episodes.overview: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.

episodes.title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
episodes.overview: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

episodes.title: To a Kinder World
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

episodes.title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
episodes.overview: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

episodes.title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
episodes.overview: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo.

episodes.title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
episodes.overview: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. The aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

episodes.title: First Love
episodes.overview: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

episodes.title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
episodes.overview: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.

episodes.title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
episodes.overview: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. The doorbell rings.

episodes.title: The Evil Eye
episodes.overview: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

episodes.title: You Won't Get Away with This!
episodes.overview: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes.title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
episodes.overview: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray... but so does the possessed Jiji.

episodes.title: We Can All Stay There Together!
episodes.overview: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

episodes.title: We Became a Family
episodes.overview: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

episodes.title: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
episodes.overview: Okarun has an awkward time at the maid café where Momo works. Seiko tries teaching Jiji how to suppress Evil Eye's possession of his body.

episodes.title: You Can Do It, Okarun!
episodes.overview: Aira and Okarun battle the classical composer spirits. As Okarun struggles to avoid their attacks, Turbo Granny orders him to feel the rhythm.

episodes.title: I Want to Rebuild the House
episodes.overview: Putting his training to the test, Okarun goes all-out and holds his own against Evil Eye, but the effort causes him to revert to his human form.

episodes.title: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
episodes.overview: Momo goes to Okarun's classroom to tell him about the golden ball spotted in the housing complex and finds him speaking with a curious classmate.

episodes.title: Hey, It's a Kaiju
episodes.overview: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

episodes.title: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
episodes.overview: As Momo and the others try to pilot the giant Buddha robot and battle the kaiju, Okarun and Jiji are ejected from the robot and land in a rice paddy.

seasonDetails.name: Tower of God
seasonDetails.overview: Reach the top, and everything will be yours. At the top of the tower exists everything in this world, and all of it can be yours. You can become a god. This is the story of the beginning and the end of Rachel, the girl who climbed the tower so she could see the stars, and Bam, the boy who needed nothing but her.

seasonDetails.name: Return of the Prince / -Workshop Battle-
seasonDetails.overview: Ja Wangnan can’t seem to pass the 20th Floor. Even after failing time and time again, he refuses to give up. On his journey, he meets a mysterious and powerful character named Viole. Wangnan invites Viole to join his team of Regulars. Their journey continues with new challenges at every turn.

episodes.title: BALL
episodes.overview: She wanted to see the stars. He wanted to be with her. What do you desire that you would give your life for? Only those with the strength to survive can acquire that which they seek at the top of the tower.

episodes.title: 3/400 (Three Four-Hundredths)
episodes.overview: Bam overcomes Headon’s test and ascends to the second level of the tower. "The Black March" Bam received from Yuri catches the attention of Khun, who toys with him. Together they aim for the top, but…

episodes.title: The Correct Door
episodes.overview: When Test Director Hansung Yu announces the subject of the test, Rak throws a tantrum, and Bam calms him. Meanwhile, the gears in Khun’s head alone are turning. Second by second, time moves forward. What will they do?

episodes.title: The Green April
episodes.overview: At the end of the first round of the Crown Game, Anaak, wielder of the ever-changing sword "The Green April," sits upon the throne. Bam, Khun, and Rak wait for the right moment to participate. Will they survive until the end of this bonus game?

episodes.title: The Crown’s Fate
episodes.overview: Bam’s team defends the crown from the looming Regulars. As they charge into battle one after alone, Bam is distracted by a lone girl. The Regulars attack Bam, but…

episodes.title: Position Selection
episodes.overview: What will Khun do after meeting Rachel? The position selection begins, and despite struggling with their assignments, the examinees grow closer. Meanwhile, someone watches them and ruminates from afar…

episodes.title: Lunch and Tag
episodes.overview: Several days have passed since Anaak and Endorsi’s feud came to a total stop. As the next "Tag" test is about to begin, dark clouds begin gathering around Bam again.

episodes.title: Khun’s Strategy
episodes.overview: Team A is awed by the overwhelming power of the Ranker. As the Regulars are attacked one after another in the dark, will Anaak make it to the exit? What is Khun’s next plan?

episodes.title: The One-Horned Ogre
episodes.overview: "My plan worked." With this declaration, Endorsi kicks her own teammate. What was the true intention of her plan to gather all the Fishermen in one location and see how the Ranker would act?

episodes.title: Beyond the Sadness
episodes.overview: Rachel suffers a grave wound. How will she feel about reuniting with Bam? As their various thoughts and intentions jumble together, each one reaches their own decision in order to move forward. What waits for them beyond their sadness?

episodes.title: Underwater Hunt (1)
episodes.overview: Another test is held to reach the top of the tower. Much has been lost and important things have been gained in order to climb the tower. Accept it all and move forward in the direction your feelings lead you.

episodes.title: Underwater Hunt (2)
episodes.overview: All manner of thoughts and intentions intersect at the chaotic final testing ground. While tossed about by a giant plot, the combatants boldly race across the battlefield. As the test reaches its climax, what resolve will Bam show to Rachel?

episodes.title: Tower of God
episodes.overview: Just as the guardian’s test is about to end, Bam is pushed off by Rachel. Time turns back to when the tower’s doors opened. How did Bam spend his time? What is the world Rachel saw?

episodes.title: Last Chance
episodes.overview: On the twentieth level, there is another test to determine who may continue to climb the tower. Many who have failed and buried their dreams gather there. However, Ja Wangnan does not want to give up and puts everything on one last chance.

episodes.title: The Strongest Regular
episodes.overview: Once all the successful candidates had gathered, the second test began. However, the Test Director makes a strange proposal to Viole, who passes the test with top marks.

episodes.title: The Trustworthy Room
episodes.overview: Viole refused to choose companions for the journey ahead. Therefore, another test is being conducted to resolve this issue.

episodes.title: Ramen and the Great Big Sky
episodes.overview: In the test on the 20th floor, the examinees are supposed to form teams and capture rooms. However, trust is a rare resource in a world that rewards betrayal.

episodes.title: The Other Team
episodes.overview: Khun continues to climb the tower, thinking of his best friend Bam. He has assembled a new team and is dragging along the sluggish Rachel. But there's much more going on behind the scenes.

episodes.title: Zygaena's Flower
episodes.overview: The team with Viole and Wangnan faces the next test on their journey to the top of the tower. But before that, they are evaluated by Viole's friends from FUG.

episodes.title: Mazino Magic
episodes.overview: The battle against Urek continues in Zygaena. In a deadly game between Urek and Viole, the stakes are Zygaena's flower. But then, everything takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Her Name Is Emily
episodes.overview: Both Khun's team and the team of Wangnan and Viole continue to climb the tower, facing the necessary trials along the way. In the process, they discover a new tool: the increasingly popular chat AI, Emile.

episodes.title: One-Winged Devil
episodes.overview: Kang Horyang shares his past with his teammates and asks Viole about the source of his power.

episodes.title: The Hand of Arlen
episodes.overview: Kang Horyang leaves to look for Cassano alone. Unable to abandon their teammate, Viole and the others go after him.

episodes.title: A Thick and Distant Wall
episodes.overview: Viole witnesses Kang Horyang's defeat and unleashes an incredible power. Meanwhile, Khun realizes he has been betrayed and rushes to save his teammates.

episodes.title: A New Trial
episodes.overview: The Hand of Arlen is destroyed by FUG. Wangnan's team rescues Khun from the rubble, who explain that the long-haired man he saw is FUG Slayer Candidate Jue Viole Grace. While contemplating recent events, Khun encounters a familiar face...

episodes.title: Archimedes
episodes.overview: Khun learns the truth from Hwaryun and decides to join Wangnan's team in the Workshop Battle. Meanwhile, Bam remains on Team FUG as Viole.

episodes.title: Meeting the Traveler
episodes.overview: Workshop Manager Io announces a game in which all participants will compete for a spot on the floating ship. As each team prepares for the start of the game, Viole rescues a Traveler being chased by a security robot in a back alley.

episodes.title: The Promise of That Day
episodes.overview: Unaware that FUG agent Viole is actually Bam, Endorsi Jahad attempts to capture him. Meanwhile, Team Shibisu launches a surprise attack on the hotel where Team FUG is staying and Wangnan and Team Khun face off against Chang and Quaetro.

episodes.title: The 25th Bam
episodes.overview: Team Shibisu arrives to confront FUG member Jue Viole Grace. In order to prevent his former teammates from discovering that he is the 25th Bam, Viole takes on Team Shibisu.

episodes.title: Funky!
episodes.overview: The participants that acquired boarding passes enjoy a moment’s rest aboard the Archimedes. Khun is reunited with Rak on the floating ship. With their determination to take back Viole (Bam) from FUG, the “Flag” Workshop Battle finally begins!

episodes.title: The Mad Dog and the Lizard
episodes.overview: As soon as the game begins, Wangnan, Prince, and Akraptor are forced to fight against Miseng, who has been driven mad by Verdi’s ability. Unable to communicate with Miseng, how will they stop her rampage?

episodes.title: ALL IN
episodes.overview: Special rules are applied to Anaak and Ran’s match, and they face off against each other one-on-one. As both combatants fight fiercely with all their strength, the gamblers become excited, and the battle finally nears its end! Meanwhile, Beta, who was created in the workshop, appears before Viole...

episodes.title: Like a Flame in the Wind
episodes.overview: The results of the individual tournament pit the two winning teams, Team Mad Dog and Team FUG, against each other in the Workshop Battle, while the losing teams advance to the training tournament. As their respective battles begin, Khun and Wangnan begin summoning their teammates.

episodes.title: The Beginning of Dawn
episodes.overview: Viole is sent to the bottom by Beta where the Thorn can be found. Reflejo appears before the massive Thorn to reveal the truth to Viole. Meanwhile, Team Khun is reunited with Team Shibisu, and they learn FUG’s true goal hidden within the Workshop Battle...

episodes.title: Their Workshop
episodes.overview: Khun and the others learn Viole is in trouble and head to the summoning station so they can rescue him. Meanwhile, Beta receives Medina the Regular as a teammate from the gambler sent by FUG. Beta allows Medina to enter his body and becomes its host, making him a legitimate competitor, as he sets out to eliminate all of Viole’s friends!

episodes.title: The End of Dawn
episodes.overview: Viole finally acquires Enryu’s “Thorn.” Reflejo, who has been trying to acquire the Thorn along with Viole, even if it means involving the entire Workshop Battle, desperately tries to prevent him from escaping. They attempt to outsmart him by summoning Viole, who is currently an item, from the shop’s summoning station, but...!

episodes.title: The Cost of Battle
episodes.overview: Viole (Bam), Khun, and Rak, who once thought each other dead, are reunited. Khun’s team makes an enemy of FUG and the Workshop, but at the suggestion of former 2nd Floor Test Admin Lero Ro, who has been secretly working to help Viole escape, they decide to leave the arena with the losers before the final begins. Reflejo uses the dying Hwaryun as a hostage to force Viole into a final confrontation.

episodes.title: Return of the King
episodes.overview: While Reflejo, Viole (Bam), Khun, and Rak are engaged in their final showdown, FUG and the Workshop attempt to pour a solution capable of melting everything into the area... Lero Ro and Endorsi rush to their three companions in order to save them, but FUG Rankers and Team Mad Dog stand in their way! Will Viole and the others be able to escape safely?!

episodes.title: The Dawn of the Departure
episodes.overview: Reflejo is brought to the brink of death using the unleashed power of the Thorn. Viole (Bam) finds himself in a difficult position. But thanks to quick thinking from Khun and Rak and Endorsi’s Bongbong, they successfully escape. Their companions gather one after another and all leave the arena on the Wolhaiksong floating ship as the turbulent Workshop Battle finally comes to a close...

episodes.title: set up/stand up
episodes.overview: "God of High School" is an all-styles martial arts tournament for high schoolers from all over Korea. Jin Mori, who lives on his own after parting ways with his grandfather Taejin at a young age, is on his way to the preliminary for his region when he ends up chasing a snatcher. In the midst of his pursuit, he meets Han Daewi and Yoo Mira, two other high schoolers on their way to participate in the preliminary. The only thing on the line is your pride! The only thing you can trust is your fists! Choose any wish, and it will be granted! Such is the power of God! So begins the battle royal featuring the most powerful contenders from all over…

episodes.title: renewal/soul
episodes.overview: Mori, Daewi, and Mirahave made it through the first preliminary round. With the next round coming up, the three of them talk about their reasons for entering the tournament. Mira says she’s hoping to find a strong man who can become the successor to her late father’s Moon Light Sword Style and rebuild her family’s dojo. On the day of the tournament, one of the favorites to win the tournament, Gang Manseok, faces off against tai chi user Go Gamdo.

episodes.title: wisdom/kingdom
episodes.overview: Mira faces off against WWD women’s pro wrestler Mah Miseon, but her swordfighting can’t keep up with Miseon’s well-built body and overwhelming strength. Mori faces the risk of being disqualified from the tournament after interfering with the match between Gang Manseok and Go Gamdo. Park Mujin, a National Assembly member and God of High School’s sponsor, tells Mori that if he can defeat Commissioner Q in a match, he will be allowed to return to the tournament. Meanwhile, as regional preliminaries continue across Korea, a secretive organization schemes behind the scenes. The "key" to fulfilling their desires turns out to be…

episodes.title: marriage/bonds
episodes.overview: The top four fighters in the preliminary have been decided. With her semifinal match against Daewi drawing near, Mira is suddenly approached by Oh Seongjin, a martial artist and successful businessman, with a marriage proposal. She agrees to marry him in exchange for his promise to restore her family’s dojo and spread the Moon Light Sword Style around the world, but marrying him means she must withdraw from the tournament… and Mori and Daewi are not okay with this.

episodes.title: ronde/hound
episodes.overview: Daewi shows no mercy in his fight against Mira with the goal of getting the money to help his friend, Woo Seungtae, who suffers from an incurable disease. Mori handily defeats his own semifinal opponent, Brazilian jiu-jitsu user Byeon Jaehee, but is angered by Daewi’s method of defeating Mira by targeting her injuries. Daewi, meanwhile, learns that Seungtae has taken a turn for the worse and strengthens his resolution even further. Then, amidst all this, Mori and Daewi face each other in the final round.

episodes.title: fear/SIX
episodes.overview: The national God of High School tournament will be a team battle between teams formed from the top three participants in each regional preliminary. Mira wins the battle for third place, meaning she will compete in the nationals with Mori and Daewi. Mujin explains to the other administrators that this is all part of the search for the one with the potential to be the "Key." At the same time, Mujin puts out a call to The Six, a group of extraordinarily powerful fighters, in order to deal with Nox, another organization searching for the Key.

episodes.title: anima/force
episodes.overview: In the first match of the national tournament, Mori loses his team’s opening bout by applying a pressure point he learned from Bongchim of The Six, which renders him immobile. The second bout pits Daewi the tournament’s oldest competitor, 38-year-old Jin Pumgwang, who overwhelms Daewi with powerful attacks acquired through years of hard physical labor. Meanwhile, Commissioner Q is attacked by Drake, a member of Nox, and seriously injured. Q ends up removing his limiter so he can call upon the power of the gods, and the charyeok Joker materializes!

episodes.title: close/friend
episodes.overview: The team led by Park Ilpyo, one of the participants considered a top Key candidate, faces the team led by Gwim Gi. Gwim Gi calls upon his charyeok, Jack the Ripper, but Ilpyo uses his antiquated taekkyon fighting style rather than relying on charyeok. Meanwhile, Daewi is suspended from the competition after interfering in a match and hitting Taek. Mira scolds him, but Mori seems distracted. Something he sees on Ilpyo's back looks familiar...

episodes.title: curse/cornered
episodes.overview: After learning that his grandfather, Jin Taejin, has been confined, Mori rushes to set him free. Daewi and Mira await his arrival at the tournament with no idea what's going on. With Mori missing and Daewi suspended, Mira is forced to kick off the team match alone. She struggles against her opponent, Marin, who evades her attacks and counters with her own sword. When he calls it a National Treasure, it begins to glow white, and its true form is revealed...

episodes.title: oath/meaning
episodes.overview: When he learns of Nox's existence and their role in Jin Taejin's confinement, Mori swears to win the tournament and save him. But his opponent, Ilpyo, also has a good reason why he can't afford to lose. Four years ago, Seungah's sister and Ilpyo's cousin, Seungyeon, had her leg broken by Jegal and had to give up martial arts for good, and Ilpyo has made up his mind to become cold-hearted for her sake. Meanwhile, Feilong, whose attack on Mori failed, is eliminated... as Jegal wears a cruel smile.

episodes.title: lay/key
episodes.overview: In his battle with Mori, Ilpyo unleashes the charyeok Nine-Tails and awakens as the Key. Mori uses his Blue Dragon Tempest, but Ilpyo stops it easily. The difference in strength between them seems clear, but then, energy suddenly surges forth from Mori's body...

episodes.title: FOX/GOD
episodes.overview: Ilpyo mercilessly beats down Jegal. Just as he's about to deal the finishing blow, Ilpyo sprouts tentacles and ensnares him. With the charyeok Greed, Jegal unleashes the charyeok powers of the others he's absorbed and turns their incredible powers upon Ilpyo. As their battle rages, something changes in the sky over the arena, and it is soon filled with a sword-wielding God and his many followers...

episodes.title: GOD/GOD
episodes.overview: The god that appeared over the arena has been shot down by Jaesan's technique. Mori and the rest have fallen into a huge cave, where they battle against Jegal, who has transformed into a god after absorbing the Key. Mori, Daewi, and Mira face him together, but their attacks don't even reach him, and Daewi is severely wounded protecting Mori from Jegal's vicious onslaught. As the situation grows desperate, a memory that had remained dormant in Mori's mind all this time reawakens...
